physiology:
The traditions seat this code at the perineum, the floor of the pelvis, the small unspoken hammock of muscle that closes the bottom of the trunk. It is the lowest gate of the body, the place the weight of you finally lands when you sit. It is fitting. This is the code of stillness, and stillness has a floor before it has a meaning. The breath only ever drops as far as this place lets it drop, and the long alarm of stress is the sound of breath that never reaches here.

The shadow has its bodily floor right at this floor. The pelvis grips without anyone teaching it to. The adrenals, sitting just above the kidneys higher in the back, run their small fire of readiness on a slow drip, day after day, and the body cannot tell that the threat is mostly imaginary. Sleep gets shallow. The breath stays up near the collarbones. A held-in restlessness sits in the seat of you, in the muscles that should be soft.

The climb out is also bodily. Sit, and let the weight go all the way down. The pelvis softens of its own accord when nothing is being held against. The breath finds the floor it had been hunting for, drops past the navel, drops past the small hammock of muscle, and meets the chair. Something the mind could not arrange happens on its own. The fire above the kidneys goes quiet. The day stops moving faster than the life it belongs to.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the pelvis, this code answers to a single amino acid, Serine. Serine is one of the small set the body builds for itself, made quietly on the spot, with no need to be brought in from outside. In the nervous system it does specific work. It is a precursor the body uses to make glycine, one of the calming signals that tells a firing nerve to settle, to stop sending, to let the next wave through without joining it.

There is a teaching in that, and it sits at the floor of this card. The substance the code rests on is one the body makes in order to quiet itself. The hush the gift is reaching for is not somewhere else. It is already being assembled, lower than any decision, while the surface of you is busy running. Stillness is not the absence of chemistry, it is a chemistry. The code runs all the way to this. A quiet the body is already making, waiting only for the rest of you to stop overriding it.
